items.headline: AURALEE and Tekla make luxe loungewear again
items.caption: Wool-cashmere knits, check flannel pyjamas and shearling slippers.
body: Danish textile brand Tekla and Japanese label AURALEE are back with a second collaboration.
Both are known for top-quality fabrics, and the range is all about cosy.
How to wear it: flannel PJ trousers with a chunky knit, at home and proud.

items.headline: Human Made opens a giant Harajuku flagship
items.caption: NIGO brings back the space-age feel of 2000s BAPE stores.
body: Human Made's first proper flagship spans three floors in Tokyo's Harajuku.
It updates the bold, futuristic store design NIGO made famous with A Bathing Ape.
Worth a stop on any Tokyo trip.

items.headline: MM6 × Salomon Crossderby: a dress shoe for trails
items.caption: A glossy derby upper on a chunky Salomon outsole.
body: It mixes a classic lace-up derby with Salomon's grippy trail sole and quick-pull laces.
The shiny finish keeps it dressy.
How to wear it: wide-leg wool trousers that just touch the sole.

items.headline: Nike's all-blue Air Force 1 'Deep Royal'
items.caption: Glossy blue panels on blue leather, with a crisp white sole.
body: Blue laces, blue Swoosh, blue outsole: only the white midsole breaks it up.
Glossy panels add depth to the classic AF1 shape.
How to wear it: everything else neutral, grey or white.

items.headline: Nike Lahar Low: a hiking boot for the city
items.caption: A chunky all-black winter stomper.
body: Thick laces and a sturdy shape give it attitude.
You don't need a full outdoor wardrobe to pull it off.
How to wear it: loose denim, baggy cargos or cords.

items.headline: Ten C × Comoli: all-black winterwear done gently
items.caption: Eight black pieces mixing performance shapes with soft Japanese fabrics.
body: The FW26 collaboration pairs Ten C's Japanese jersey with Comoli's cotton flannel and crinkled nylon.
It's black, but soft and practical rather than severe.
How to wear it: head-to-toe black in different textures.

items.headline: Carter Young: the suit label everyone's talking about
items.caption: American designer Carter Altman's London brand does relaxed tailoring.
body: The label is American at heart but made in an East London studio.
Think easy, lived-in tailoring rather than stiff suits.
How to wear it: an unstructured jacket with a tee.

items.headline: The shiny dress shirt is back
items.caption: Glossy going-out shirts from the early 2000s return, worn by Pedro Pascal and Riz Ahmed.
body: Pedro Pascal wore a lime-green shiny shirt by label Aubero on a red carpet.
Riz Ahmed also wore sheen on a recent press tour.
How to wear it: one shiny piece, everything else matte.

items.headline: HBO's 'War' goes all in on Savile Row
items.caption: Dominic West's tech heir dresses like he's always heading to a board meeting.
body: The British divorce drama stars Dominic West and Sienna Miller.
Costume designer Matt Price uses classic British tailoring to show class and power.
How to wear it: a navy suit, white shirt, no tie.

items.headline: SNL's Please Don't Destroy model for J.Crew
items.caption: The comedy trio front J.Crew's new suiting campaign.
body: John Higgins, Ben Marshall and Martin Herlihy went viral on TikTok before joining SNL in 2021.
Fashion's playful mood is putting comedians in big campaigns.
How to wear it: a relaxed suit, worn like you're in on the joke.

items.headline: American selvedge denim is back
items.caption: Mount Vernon Mills is shipping its first US-made selvedge rolls.
body: The mill bought Cone White Oak's famous old looms less than a year ago.
Brands are lining up for the flat, classic mid-century style denim.
How to wear it: raw selvedge, cuffed once, with boots.

items.headline: Tyler, the Creator designs Barcelona's special kit
items.caption: Golf Wang takes over FC Barcelona's shirt for a big match.
body: Through Spotify's artist takeover deal, Barça wears a limited artist jersey twice a season.
Past artists include Rosalía, Travis Scott and Olivia Rodrigo.
How to wear it: a football shirt with wide trousers and loafers.

items.headline: Ethan Hawke nails the brown corduroy suit
items.caption: The easiest autumn look: a brown cord two-piece.
body: Hawke wore it while promoting season two of The Lowdown in New York.
Corduroy suits are back, helped by fans like Wes Anderson.
How to wear it: brown cord, an open-collar shirt, loafers.

items.headline: A no-drill cavity treatment nears US approval
items.caption: A painless liquid could spare kids from drilling and surgery.
body: Silver diamine fluoride is brushed onto a cavity in seconds and stops decay, with no shots or sedation.
Dentists in many countries have used it for decades.
A big Phase 3 trial could now win it FDA approval to treat cavities.

items.headline: A 715,000-acre Amazon reserve protects a 'link of life'
items.caption: Bolivia's Iténez River corridor gets protection for jaguars, river dolphins and giant otters.
body: Rainforest Trust helped create the reserve along the river that borders Bolivia and Brazil.
The river is home to 260 fish species, 25 found nowhere else.
It links protected areas so animals can keep migrating.

items.headline: A wrong turn saves a big foster family from a fire
items.caption: A stranger's GPS sent him down the wrong road, right past a burning house.
body: Casey spotted smoke and woke James Burke, asleep in his recliner, in rural Georgia.
The Burkes, who have fostered about 500 children, had 11 kids and a grandchild at home.
Everyone got out.
